segments.sn55.54:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sakkesu viharati kapilavatthusmiṃ nigrodhārāme.
segments.sn55.54:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena sambahulā bhikkhū bhagavato cīvarakammaṃ karonti –
segments.sn55.54:1.7: Atha kho mahānāmo sakko yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho mahānāmo sakko bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn55.54:1.11: Na kho netaṃ [na kho te etaṃ (sī. pī.)], bhante, bhagavato sammukhā sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ
segments.sn55.54:1.12: sappaññena upāsakena sappañño upāsako ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno ovaditabbo”ti.
segments.sn55.54:2.1: “Sappaññena mahānāma, upāsakena sappañño upāsako ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno catūhi assāsanīyehi dhammehi assāsetabbo –
segments.sn55.54:2.3: atthāyasmato buddhe aveccappasādo itipi so bhagavā…pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti.
segments.sn55.54:3.1: “Sappaññena, mahānāma, upāsakena sappañño upāsako ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno imehi catūhi assāsanīyehi dhammehi assāsetvā evamassa vacanīyo –
segments.sn55.54:3.4: ‘atthi me mātāpitūsu apekkhā’ti, so evamassa vacanīyo –
segments.sn55.54:3.6: Sace pāyasmā mātāpitūsu apekkhaṃ karissati, marissateva;
segments.sn55.54:3.7: no ce pāyasmā mātāpitūsu apekkhaṃ karissati, marissateva.
segments.sn55.54:3.8: Sādhāyasmā, yā te mātāpitūsu apekkhā taṃ pajahā’”ti.
segments.sn55.54:4.2: ‘yā me mātāpitūsu apekkhā sā pahīnā’ti, so evamassa vacanīyo –
segments.sn55.54:4.5: ‘atthi me puttadāresu apekkhā’ti, so evamassa vacanīyo –
segments.sn55.54:4.7: Sace pāyasmā puttadāresu apekkhaṃ karissati, marissateva;
segments.sn55.54:4.8: no ce pāyasmā puttadāresu apekkhaṃ karissati, marissateva.
segments.sn55.54:4.9: Sādhāyasmā, yā te puttadāresu apekkhā taṃ pajahā’”ti.
segments.sn55.54:5.2: ‘yā me puttadāresu apekkhā sā pahīnā’ti, so evamassa vacanīyo –
segments.sn55.54:5.5: ‘atthi me mānusakesu pañcasu kāmaguṇesu apekkhā’ti, so evamassa vacanīyo –
segments.sn55.54:5.6: ‘mānusakehi kho, āvuso, kāmehi dibbā kāmā abhikkantatarā ca paṇītatarā ca.
segments.sn55.54:5.7: Sādhāyasmā, mānusakehi kāmehi cittaṃ vuṭṭhāpetvā cātumahārājikesu [cātummahārājikesu (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] devesu cittaṃ adhimocehī’”ti.
segments.sn55.54:6.2: ‘mānusakehi me kāmehi cittaṃ vuṭṭhitaṃ, cātumahārājikesu devesu cittaṃ adhimocita’nti, so evamassa vacanīyo –
segments.sn55.54:6.3: ‘cātumahārājikehi kho, āvuso, devehi tāvatiṃsā devā abhikkantatarā ca paṇītatarā ca.
segments.sn55.54:6.4: Sādhāyasmā, cātumahārājikehi devehi cittaṃ vuṭṭhāpetvā tāvatiṃsesu devesu cittaṃ adhimocehī’”ti.
segments.sn55.54:7.2: ‘cātumahārājikehi me devehi cittaṃ vuṭṭhitaṃ, tāvatiṃsesu devesu cittaṃ adhimocita’nti, so evamassa vacanīyo –
segments.sn55.54:7.7: paranimmitavasavattīhi kho, āvuso, devehi brahmaloko abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro ca.
segments.sn55.54:7.8: Sādhāyasmā, paranimmitavasavattīhi devehi cittaṃ vuṭṭhāpetvā brahmaloke cittaṃ adhimocehī’ti.
segments.sn55.54:7.10: ‘paranimmitavasavattīhi me devehi cittaṃ vuṭṭhitaṃ, brahmaloke cittaṃ adhimocita’nti, so evamassa vacanīyo –
segments.sn55.54:7.12: Sādhāyasmā, brahmalokā cittaṃ vuṭṭhāpetvā sakkāyanirodhe cittaṃ upasaṃharāhī’”ti.
segments.sn55.54:8.2: ‘brahmalokā me cittaṃ vuṭṭhitaṃ, sakkāyanirodhe cittaṃ upasaṃharāmī’ti;
segments.sn55.54:8.3: evaṃ vimuttacittassa kho, mahānāma, upāsakassa āsavā [vassasata (sī. syā.)] vimuttacittena bhikkhunā na kiñci nānākaraṇaṃ vadāmi, yadidaṃ –

lines: Catutthe na kho panetanti na kho amhehi etaṃ.
Yadidaṃ vimuttiyā vimuttanti yaṃ idaṃ vimuttiṃ ārabbha vimuttiyā nānākaraṇaṃ vattabbaṃ siyā, na taṃ vadāmi.

Bhikkhusaṅghassa hi cetiyaṅgaṇabodhiyaṅgaṇavattesu ceva asītikkhandhakavattesu cāti āgamanīyaguṇesu pamāṇaṃ nāma natthi, paṭividdhe pana magge vā phale vā upāsakānañca bhikkhūnañca nānākaraṇaṃ natthi. 9.
Na kho panetanti na kho etaṃ, noti ca amhehīti atthoti āha “na kho amhehī”tiādi.
Marissatīti māriso, ekantabhāvimaraṇo, so pana maraṇādhīnavuttikoti vuttaṃ “maraṇapaṭibaddho”ti.
Taṃ pana tathā cittassa paṇidhānaṃ ṭhapananti āha “ṭhapehī”ti.
